title: Isolate and lock out
instructions: Stop, isolate and lock out the saw. Remove product.

title: Dry clean
instructions: Remove bone dust and scraps by hand.

title: Pre-rinse
instructions: Rinse top to bottom with warm water.

title: Apply foam
instructions: Foam all surfaces bottom to top.

title: Let foam work
instructions: Leave foam on. Do not let it dry.

title: ATP swab
instructions: Swab the blade guard and enter the reading.
